title: Visit to the Alhambra palaces with Marta
text: We enjoyed our visit to the Alhambra palaces and the Generalife very much; our guide, Marta Soler, was approachable and kind, demonstrated excellent knowledge of its history and architecture, and managed to make the visit not only informative, but also enjoyable.
author: K8249WMandrews

title: Our October Alhambra Palaces Tour
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our tour of the Alhambra Palaces and Generalife, our guide Marta Soler was warm and friendly, she had an excellent knowledge of its history and architecture, and made the visit not only informative but entertaining.
author: Venture754586

title: Great tour and excellent guide
text:
I really enjoyed the tour! I was worried that I might be late arriving in Granada by bus, so I contacted the team beforehand. They were incredibly helpful, friendly, and patient, and helped me figure out the best way to reach the meeting point on time.

Our tour guide Marta was also very kind, knowledgeable, and informative, which made the experience even more enjoyable. And of course, the Alhambra itself was simply breathtaking — absolutely worth seeing!

I highly recommend this tour! 🇪🇸✨
author: 538ayshanh

title: Good
text:
Good tour! Advance communication was good (our tour was postponed by an hour) and the meeting point was well displayed. Upon arrival, we met our guide: Marta Soler, a young, friendly lady who could tell you everything about the Alhambra, about the palaces, the gardens. The sound through the earpiece was good enough and there was room for questions and interactivity. 

Maybe as a small tip; a bit more background information on the history at the beginning (although this did come up occasionally in between). The road to the Alhambra was also quite tough (hot and stylish). Good to know this in ad
